_readme: The FraudShield mark, in one place. A shield (the product protects) holding a lens (it inspects before you act). It deliberately has no tick: a tick says safe, and this product never says safe (ADR-0007, ADR-0025). The SVG files, every PNG, the social card and the React Logo component are all generated from this file by scripts/build_brand.js; edit here, then run `npm run brand:build`.
